meta.name: study-img
meta.description: Image-reading sub-skill (orchestrated by study-assistant; also usable standalone). Use for ANY study material that must be visually inspected: scanned textbook pages, courseware figures/charts/diagrams, photographed exam papers, photos of handwritten answers or notes, and png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp/bmp files. Supports OCR, teaching-grade figure descriptions, and verbatim handwritten-answer transcription.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别并提取学习材料中的文字与图表信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从图片中提取文字或图表内容用于学习
copy.tagline_en: Extract text and diagram information from study materials
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract text or diagram content from images for study

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能读取图片中的文字、图表和手写答案，并输出结构化内容（如 Markdown、LaTeX 公式）。
howto.when: 当你上传扫描的课本页、课件图、考试卷或手写笔记等图片时触发。

say.text: 帮我识别这张课本图片中的文字。
say.note: 触发 OCR 模式，输出结构化文本。

say.text: 解释这张图表的数据趋势。
say.note: 触发 figure 模式，生成教学级描述。

say.text: 转录这张手写答案，保留原样。
say.note: 触发 answer 模式，逐字转录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read text, figures, and handwritten answers from images, outputting structured content like Markdown and LaTeX formulas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload images such as scanned textbook pages, courseware figures, exam papers, or handwritten notes.

say_en.text: Transcribe the text from this textbook image.
say_en.note: Triggers OCR mode for structured text.

say_en.text: Explain the data trend in this chart.
say_en.note: Triggers figure mode for teaching-grade description.
Triggers answer mode for verbatim transcription.
